name: Hyperspace
description: Stars streaming outward through a nebula, with warp streaks that stretch as the track opens up and a core everything converges on. Flow is one-directional and only occasionally eases backwards.

speed.description: Forward flow rate. Kept modest — this is travel, not a strobe.

rollback.description: How far the flow eases backwards on its slow cycle. 0 never reverses; above ~0.5 it reverses for a noticeable stretch.

rollRate.description: How often a roll-back happens. 0.09 is roughly one every 70 seconds.

layers.description: Depth shells of stars. More is a denser sky and a little more cost.

streak.description: Radial elongation of the stars themselves.

warpLines.description: Long hyperspace trails over the top of the field. Their length rides the energy, so a chorus accelerates instead of merely brightening.

nebula.description: The cloud the field flies through. 0 is the old black sky.

core.description: Glow at the vanishing point everything converges on.
